conclusions: On an archived template upper requiring recovery, ro,noload reproduces EBADMSG 74; journal-only replay on a new copy makes root inode 131073 readable.
This proves an unsafe journal-handling condition in the sealing path; exact original capture causality is limited because critical failed images were deleted.
Do not equate fsck exit 0 with full integrity: free block/inode count warnings remain after journal-only replay.
No evidence attributes the original failure to 0.1-second monitoring or capacity exhaustion.
